kind: proposed platform routes and state machine; these are NOT ABC endpoints

routes.requires: valid platform identity, active org membership, connections.manage; CSRF protection for cookie session
routes.server_behavior: Resolve fixed ABC client/profile and callback; persist single-use transaction bound to session/user/org; generate state and PKCE S256; redirect to ABC authorization endpoint.
Verify single-use state and initiating context before token redemption; exchange server-side with correct ABC client auth; commit tokens atomically; verify returned grant; discover accounts.
routes.output: redacted connection summary; token set remains private

routes.requires: owner/admin local permission and provider-authorized account evidence
routes.server_behavior: Intersect user-visible ABC accounts with application-approved customer-org account bindings; persist ACL and evidence time.
routes.output: active scoped connection; does not create an ABC account
state, allowed capabilities, redacted account names and last verification time; no credentials

routes.server_behavior: Immediately disable local token use, cancel queued customer operations, remove token access, attempt provider revocation using a tested client profile, and retain minimal audit evidence.
routes.output: local disconnection status and separate provider-revocation result

layers: application customer-org membership and operation policy

lifecycle.on_login_change: invalidate pending linking transaction; do not attach credentials to a different Entra user
lifecycle.on_membership_revocation: deny broker calls regardless of remaining ABC access-token validity
lifecycle.on_refresh_invalid_grant: mark reauth_required; stop customer work until reconnect
lifecycle.on_scope_upgrade: request provider-approved consent again; do not claim local role assignment enlarged ABC grant

refresh_rules: one distributed refresh lock per token set
read expiry metadata; use a configured skew buffer
atomically replace any returned refresh token and access token using record revision
do not log tokens/codes/secrets; store last refresh outcome and provider correlation identifiers only
client_credentials obtains a new application token, never uses a refresh token
never use a TPA application token as fallback for failed customer pricing/order authorization
